title: Service Interval Countdown Under Five Hundred Miles
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=smartcar:vehicle
| stats latest(odometer_mi) as odometer_mi, latest(next_service_due_mi) as next_service_due_mi by vin
| eval miles_left=round(next_service_due_mi-odometer_mi,0)
| where miles_left>=0 AND miles_left<500
| sort miles_left
description: Uses Smartcar vehicle data telemetry to monitor remaining distance before the next service interval in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cars that are about to need workshop time, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Smartcar vehicle data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Mileage runway table to next service.
grandmaExplanation: It lists remaining distance before the next service interval so you can spot cars that are about to need workshop time before it becomes annoying.
